title: Choose the visual world for GymShift
question: Safer hand, now in the club's black, red and white (from the listing photos). Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Staff Pass
options.lineage: Gym membership and staff ID cards: black card, white name, the one thing you show at the door
options.thesis: Today's shift is your pass: a black card with your name and shift, and the button that swipes you in or out.
options.viewport: Light page; a black pass card holding the night shift, live status and time worked; a full-width club-red Clock out button; location and extension rows; upcoming shifts list.
options.risk: Familiar and safe. Its character rests entirely on the black card, so it needs crisp type to avoid looking generic.

options.label: Class Timetable
options.lineage: The gym's printed class timetable: day columns, coloured class blocks, times in bold
options.thesis: Shifts are coded like gym classes: night is a solid black block, morning is a red-outlined block, so you can tell them apart without reading.
options.viewport: White page; today's shift as a solid black night block with times in bold; a big Clock out button; status rows; upcoming shifts as coloured blocks by type.
options.risk: The black/red coding only works if every screen uses it the same way, forever.

options.label: Timecard
options.lineage: The paper timecard and stamp clock it replaces: IN / OUT columns, a stamped time
options.thesis: Every clock-in lands as a red stamped time in IN / OUT columns, the same record people trusted on paper.
options.viewport: White page; today's shift as a card with IN 6:57 pm stamped in red and OUT empty; a big black Clock out button; status rows; upcoming shifts in a clean table.
options.risk: It can tip into nostalgia; red stamp ink must mean 'recorded', never 'problem'.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Deputy, Connecteam and Homebase, at their best: white cards and a big clock button with a timer.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, a shift card, a large circular Clock out button with a timer ring, then an upcoming list.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every rostering app, and nothing ties it to World Gym.
